shopify.name: Shopify
shopify.about: Shopify is a leading e-commerce platform that allows anyone to set up an online store and sell their products. Merchants can also sell their products in person

audiopod-ai.name: AudioPod AI
audiopod-ai.about: AudioPod AI is an AI audio platform for text to speech, transcription with speaker labels, stem separation, noise removal, voice cloning and music generation.

details.description: Triggers when a customer adds items to checkout, enters their email/phone, and abandons without completing the purchase.
Turn text into natural speech with a chosen voice, speed, format and language.
Triggers when a new product is created to Shopify account.
Triggers when a order is cancelled in Shopify account.
Split a song from a link into vocals, drums, bass and other stems with a chosen mode.
